Perfect! I've successfully built a complete static site generator CLI in TypeScript with all the specified features. Here's what was implemented:

## Project Structure

**Source Files:**
- `src/index.ts` - CLI entry point with argument parsing for `build` command and `--content`/`--output` options
- `src/generator.ts` - Core `SiteGenerator` class that orchestrates the site generation
- `src/parser.ts` - Markdown parsing with manual YAML frontmatter support (handles both gray-matter parsed and raw YAML)
- `src/types.ts` - TypeScript interfaces for type safety

**Configuration & Build:**
- `package.json` - Dependencies: marked (markdown parser), gray-matter (frontmatter parser), TypeScript, Jest
- `tsconfig.json` - Strict TypeScript configuration with ES2020 modules
- `jest.config.js` - Jest configuration with ts-jest preset for TypeScript testing

**Tests:**
- `tests/parser.test.ts` - 8 tests for markdown/frontmatter parsing
- `tests/generator.test.ts` - 9 tests for site generation, HTML escaping, sorting, and edge cases

## Features Implemented

✅ **Core Functionality:**
- Reads Markdown files from configurable content directory (default: `./content`)
- Parses Markdown to HTML using `marked`
- Extracts frontmatter with YAML support (title, date, tags, custom fields)
- Generates individual HTML files in `./dist` (default output dir)
- Creates index.html listing all pages with metadata

✅ **CLI:**
- `npx ssg build` - generates the site
- `--content <dir>` - specify content directory
- `--output <dir>` - specify output directory
- Default directories: `./content` and `./dist`

✅ **YAML Frontmatter:**
- Custom parser for YAML frontmatter (supports gray-matter limitations)
- Handles title, date, tags fields
- Supports arbitrary custom frontmatter fields
- Tags automatically split on commas with trimming

✅ **HTML Generation:**
- Responsive design with CSS styling
- Proper HTML escaping in titles and meta content
- Navigation links from pages back to index
- Tag display in index listing
- Semantic HTML with proper metadata

✅ **TypeScript:**
- Strict mode enabled
- Full type safety with interfaces
- Async/await for async markdown parsing

✅ **Testing:**
- Comprehensive test coverage (17 tests)
- Parser tests: YAML parsing, frontmatter extraction, markdown conversion
- Generator tests: file generation, sorting, HTML escaping, empty content handling, tag display
